title: Insecure patterns view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's insecure-patterns view: the scope's findings as of as_of (false positives dropped) grouped by primary CWE within each corpus ownership class, ranked by distinct repositories, then occurrences. An occurrence is one (repository, path) pair; a repository several ownership classes ship counts in each. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included; lists are never null. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The filter's point in time; null reads the current recorded state.

cuts.description: One cut per ownership class that has a pattern or a finding without a CWE, in the ownership registry's order, then the repositories no registered product ships (ownership null).

cut.description: One ownership class's patterns, ranked on their own, never folded together.

ownership.description: The corpus ownership class; null for repositories no registered product ships.

without_cwe.description: Occurrences whose finding carries no CWE, so fit no pattern.

patterns.description: Patterns by most repositories, then most occurrences, then CWE.

pattern.description: The findings sharing a primary CWE.

cwe.description: The primary CWE id as recorded, raw.

asvs.description: The first ASVS label among the pattern's occurrences (by repository URL, then path), raw; null when none carries one.

occurrences.description: Distinct (repository, path) pairs; a re-report counts once, at its highest severity.

examples.description: Up to six occurrences, by repository URL, then path.

path.description: The occurrence's first location path, raw; empty when the finding has no location.
